testCase:
G-001: Same word everywhere: menu vs product card
Goal: Add the Halvorsen pole kit from the Transformers category to the cart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/index.html#s1
STEP 2: Click "Transformers" in the top menu
STEP 3: Verify that 'Browsing category: Transformers' is visible
STEP 4: Click the "Transformers" button in the product card
STEP 5: Verify that 'Cart: 1 × Halvorsen pole kit' is visible

plan.title: Add Halvorsen pole kit via Transformers

steps.note: Choose Transformers in the top menu.
Confirm the Transformers category is open.
Click the identically named button in the intended product card.
Confirm the cart contains one Halvorsen pole kit.

reasoning: This tests that the Transformers menu entry opens the category and the identically named product-card button adds the Halvorsen pole kit. Scoped clicks distinguish the two controls, with assertions confirming the category and cart contents.
